method: Shared ExtraTrees on within-person sensor differences and carb differences. Symmetric correction, average historical day carb + predicted change. Never give current carb label as input.
selection: Same existing29 chronological validation days, MAPE then MAE; leaf2/5/10; shape/glucose/context; personal mean baseline included.
caveat: Pair rows reuse days and are not independent observations. Earliest validation fold has very few same-person training pairs. Reused development data.
